body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If you already damaged this target this turn, deal +1 weapon damage.

surges.html: Deal +1 weapon damage. If the target is already wounded, this costs 1 fewer Surge, minimum 1.
If you began this Action below your maximum Core Wounds, deal +1 weapon damage.

rider.title: BLITZ
rider.html: After this Action deals damage, you may spend 1 Combo to gain +1 die on your next Prowess Action this turn.
